name: Cboe Global Markets
description: Cboe operates options exchanges (including index options and futures that it has the exclusive right to list and trade per its 10-K), U.S. and European cash equity exchanges, a futures exchange and an FX trading platform, and sells market data. Revenue was $4.7 billion in 2025 but $2.3 billion of that is cost of revenues (mostly liquidity payments and routing on equities), leaving $2.4 billion; options produced 52 percent of revenue and 75 percent of segment operating income. Fees are charged per contract or per share traded, so volatility and volume drive results. Data sales (Data Vantage) were $636 million.

businessLines.name: Options
businessLines.how: Per-contract fees on options traded on options traded on its U.S. options exchanges, including index options and futures it lists exclusively, plus market data and access fees; cost of revenues is liquidity and clearing costs (902.5).

businessLines.name: Europe and Asia Pacific
